scope: MATRIX-A01 through MATRIX-A04-DIAG plus the current offline repair and zero-Provider browser regression

historical_batches.main_learning: The stream consumer could end before shared accounting received a terminal state; evidence input and session-detail path contracts also diverged.

All journeys reached useful real-model behavior, but all six failed because evidence, artifact identity, result addressing, chart semantics, publication identity, tool schema, and process lifecycle were separate contracts.
Closed request receipts did not prove the Web process exited normally; this led to a frozen parent supervisor.

The supervisor worked for M01-M03. Real output still exposed time-scope projection and unsafe narrative publication, while M04 showed that manually repeating derived authorization hashes was an avoidable launch hazard.

historical_totals.authorization_state: A01-A04 consumed and closed; no unused capacity is reusable

systemic_root_causes.title: The same analysis fact had several incompatible contracts
systemic_root_causes.detail: Tool names, typed result payloads, receipt detail references, evidence fields, chart arrays, Workbench state, public reply text, and export bytes were validated independently. A locally correct calculation could therefore fail or be misrepresented in a later surface.

systemic_root_causes.title: Publication validation happened after unsafe text had already entered the public projection
systemic_root_causes.detail: A04 M01 proved that detecting a semantic violation and failing the run was insufficient when the rejected answer remained visible and exportable.

systemic_root_causes.title: Offline fixtures were too idealized
systemic_root_causes.detail: Earlier green suites covered selected scripted shapes. Real-model runs produced nested statistical details, analyze_time_series results, numpy-like sandbox text, multiple records in one second, long detail reads, unsupported tool combinations, and multi-segment replies. Those composition cases were absent from the fixtures.

systemic_root_causes.title: Completion was represented by unrelated states
systemic_root_causes.detail: Request terminal state, analysis turn completion, task counters, evidence completeness, publication eligibility, export identity, and process exit were not one invariant. Treating one as proof of another caused false progress and repeated late failures.

systemic_root_causes.title: The operator launch surface duplicated frozen identity
systemic_root_causes.detail: The batch digest already committed to source, launcher, supervisor, data, prompts, oracles, and cases, yet every case launch required those hashes to be manually repeated. A04 M04 failed on a missing sha256 prefix before any call.

repair.principle: Keep the existing Route A product and make cross-surface invariants explicit; do not add a parallel runtime or raise Provider budgets.

changes.behavior: Project analyze_time_series fields, bind observation windows only to receipt-verified current datasets, preserve native metrics when a supplemental untyped sandbox receipt is present, and prevent model-supplied time_scope_source from bypassing recomputation.

Keep a rejected final answer internal, request one bounded rewrite using existing evidence and no tools, exclude rejected content from UI/export projection, strip the internal marker before Provider-shaped history, and fail closed if the rewrite still violates the contract.

Require the external batch digest, recompute every committed component, and propagate the verified source and launcher identities internally to the nested case guard. Accept an equivalent bare 64-hex digest, while any supplied legacy derived hash still fails closed on mismatch.
Replay A04-shaped result and evidence payloads, cover rejected-publication isolation and one rewrite, and prove the single-digest authorization gate.

read_only_real_evidence_reprojection.M01: curve-fit evidence becomes complete; unsupported zero-semantics evidence correctly remains missing because no typed metrics support it

zero_provider_real_browser.M03_chart: 15 labels, maximum 18 characters, zero overlapping pairs
zero_provider_real_browser.source_qualification: The six browser journeys ran after all product-runtime repairs. The only later controlled-source change was the acceptance batch identity handoff plus its tests; no product browser/runtime file changed afterward.

superseded_A05.reason: Batch-verified source and launcher identities were not propagated to the nested case guard.

rejected semantic narrative remaining in the public UI/export projection
manual repetition of all derived authorization hashes
A03/A04 process-exit proof for local supervised browser runs
single batch digest propagation into the nested single-case source and launcher guard
open_risks: Current source has no real-Provider result. Offline and scripted browser green cannot establish real-model convergence or six-case acceptance.
The bounded publication rewrite is proven by tests, but has not yet been exercised against the configured real model.
A04 M01's unsupported zero-semantics evidence cannot be repaired retroactively and remains correctly non-publishable.
A01 ordinal 22 remains a historical unknown; this repair does not infer its Provider billing or remote terminal state.
Arbitrary narrative correctness cannot be proven by a finite allowlist; unsupported claims still require fail-closed publication review.
